_comment: Critical surfaces that MUST reference an idempotency primitive. Scanner walks each directory; files matching excludeFilenamePatterns are skipped (models/DTOs/validators/tests aren't mutation entry points). Three levels of non-enforcement: `exceptions` (truly don't need idempotency, e.g., read-only services), `grandfatheredGaps` (known current gaps tracked as warnings — remove from list as each is fixed), and new violations (unexpected — fail CI).

_exceptionNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi: Read-only service — no mutations, no idempotency needed.

Read-only derivation service. Exports deriveStatusFromAmounts (pure fn) and deriveInvoiceStatus (findOne + aggregate → returns a status string). No updateOne / save / create / $set. Status writes happen in the callers (ledger.orchestrator.service.js, invoices.routes.js, reconciliation.service.js); conditional-update hardening belongs there, not here.

_grandfatheredNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/refunds/refund: Mount Idempotency-Key middleware on POST /refunds. BLOCKER: the middleware file (src/middleware/idempotency.middleware.js) lives only as uncommitted prior WIP — route would break if mounted before that file is committed. Wait on middleware commit, then mount.

processRefund({organizationId, paymentId, amount, reason, processedByUserId}, req) — no idempotencyKey / externalRef in signature. Mutations at L180 (Refund.create) + L202 (FinancialLedger.create). Transaction provides atomicity, not dedup. Options, all prohibited by current rules: (a) add idempotencyKey param — API change; (b) unique index on {organizationId, paymentId} — needs data audit for legit multi-refund cases; (c) runtime check 'already refunded this payment' — the invariant at L15 says this exists but is runtime-only, not schema-enforced. REAL FIX: extend the API to carry idempotencyKey from the HTTP route → thread into ensureIdempotent(Refund, key, session) at the transaction boundary.
_grandfatheredNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi: Untracked file (?? status, 161 lines). CANNOT commit under this work's author line — requires the original author to commit the prior WIP first, then harden separately.

Clean file, 82 lines, 0 mutation calls (grep for .create/.updateOne/.save → none). Likely a false-positive same as invoiceStatus.service.js — re-audit and reclassify to `exceptions` if confirmed read-only.

Natural key exists: {organizationId, billingCycleStart, status: 'draft'} at L144. Current logic = findOne + (update existing OR create new) — concurrent-create race possible. Safe fix needs unique index on {organizationId, billingCycleStart} — prohibited without data audit. Caller (generateBillingInvoice) doesn't accept an idempotencyKey; adding one = API change. Per spec: SKIP until either (a) data audit clears unique-index creation, or (b) caller API is extended.

CRITICAL financial path. 7 mutation sites (FinancialLedger.create × 5, PatientInvoice.updateOne × 2) inside a 630-line file. Uses referenceId: invoice._id / payment._id as domain link, NOT as dedup key. No idempotencyKey in signatures. +30 lines of uncommitted prior WIP in working tree — editing mixes WIP with fix. The two PatientInvoice.updateOne calls (L393, L514) are candidate conditional-update sites (spec's pending→paid pattern) — but verifying requires reading the full flow. Needs domain expert + clean working tree.
Untracked file (?? status, 720 lines). Same blocker as clinicBillingSettings: cannot commit unreviewed prior WIP. Needs original author to commit + idempotency-key API thread-through.
_grandfatheredNotes.src/jobs/controllers/job.controller.js: qstashMessageId is available as a natural dedup key. File has per-process Map dedup (L44, processedMessages, TTL-bounded). +116 lines of uncommitted prior WIP in working tree — almost certainly someone's in-progress distributed-dedup migration. Shipping a fix here now risks double-work with theirs. Wait for that WIP to land, then harden if still needed.
